description: Fit-free KC19 consumption test of the three derived bar-odd meridian candidates from the #3691 deformed-rung tower (Im V_b truncation 0.05706, resummed 0.05855, odd-only 0.05679). Value level: all three sit at the |S| scale (ratios 0.17-0.69 per anchor) but S sign-flips while each candidate is one smooth number — scale-only, same verdict class as the Phi_b handles. Slope level: the anchor swing equals S'(q*)*(q_p - q_mu) with S' ~ 3.8e6 (verified <5%), so any c3-level geometric source needs a 1e6 slope that smooth t=ln q rungs cannot supply — excluded at c3 level, scope-(a). Correct consumption level is the numerator N_odd = S*u^3 (dN/dq = O(1)); required per-anchor KC19 departures dw_odd reported as the normalization-bearing target. Decisive follow-up: tall-ladder d(kappa-tilde)/dq at both anchors. No c_k wired; no fit.
